name: toggle-group
useFor: Use type="single" for one view choice or type="multiple" for filters that can combine (Airlines, Hotels, Software). The default sits in the tab track; use variant="outline" for toolbar keys, with spacing={0} to join them. Use SegmentedControl for a single choice whose blue key should glide.
constraints: Mixing the track and outline styles in one group
More than six choices in a track
A gliding key in a multiple group
source: Extrapolated from agentcard.com/pricing (.plan-tabs) and the brand's keys
title: Toggle Group
description: Keys in the sunken tab track, the chosen ones blue; or separate white keys that stay pressed.
